description: Edits Fortnite's own GameUserSettings.ini on this PC — the same file the in-game video settings screen writes. Useful when the game will not start at a resolution your monitor can show.

running.title: Fortnite is running
running.note: Fortnite rewrites this file when it closes, so it will undo anything saved now. Close the game first.

missing.title: No settings file yet
missing.note: Launch Fortnite once so it writes its settings, then reload this page.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.note: ResolutionSizeX/Y, between {{min}} and {{max}}. The matching LastUserConfirmed values are written too.

fullscreen-mode.label: Display mode
fullscreen-mode.note: Written to FullscreenMode, PreferredFullscreenMode and LastConfirmedFullscreenMode together.

vsync.label: VSync
vsync.note: bUseVSync. Caps the frame rate to your display refresh rate.

frame-rate-limit.label: Frame rate limit
frame-rate-limit.note: FrameRateLimit, up to {{max}}. Use 0 for unlimited.

resolution-quality.label: 3D resolution
resolution-quality.note: sg.ResolutionQuality. Renders the world at {{value}}% and upscales it to the resolution above; the interface stays sharp.

backup.label: Backup
backup.note: A copy of the file is saved next to it before every write, as GameUserSettings.ini.penny.bak.
